details.completeness_justification: All six key information units are adequately represented in the candidate summary. K1 is covered by S9 (capacity increase and growth percentage). K2 is covered by S2 (revenue growth), S4 (operating profit growth), S6 (net loss context), and S7 (adjusted performance and one-off items). K3 is covered by S15 (improved financing rates and terms) and S18 (bond repayment extension). K4 is covered by S11 (expansion into Chongqing), S12 (regulatory tariff adjustments), and S13 (revenue impact assessment). K5 is covered by S9 (production volume and CO2 reduction implied by output growth). K6 is covered by S10 (contract and backlog figures). No material omissions affect the overall understanding of the report.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build upon each other without contradiction: operational growth metrics (S1-S5) are consistently presented with supporting explanations for variances (S3, S7, S12-S13). Financial improvements (S4-S5, S15-S16) logically connect to strategic actions (S14, S18). Operational expansion details (S8-S11) align with revenue drivers (S2). The net loss narrowing (S6) is plausibly explained by cost reductions (S7, S15). No arithmetic contradictions exist because the summary never claims exhaustive additivity between segment figures. Organization flows logically from overview to financials to operations to strategy. There is no unnecessary repetition, and all relationships between causes and effects are clearly articulated.
